title: Lois complains about her boss

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Hey, do you ever want to just take up drinking. Or drugs?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, do you ever want to just take up drinking. Or drugs?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Yes. Someone should invent a man that's a good person.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. Someone should invent a man that's a good person.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Apologies! I should rephrase. Someone should invent a BOSS that's a good person.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Apologies! I should rephrase. Someone should invent a BOSS that's a good person.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Could you recommend some? What do you take to forget how much you hate your life?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Could you recommend some? What do you take to forget how much you hate your life?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you want to talk about this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you want to talk about this?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you want to talk about this?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you want to talk about this?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: I am! And... it's not you I'm mad at. Maybe we aren't close enough for me to vent at you like this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am! And... it's not you I'm mad at. Maybe we aren't close enough for me to vent at you like this?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: I... do. Thanks. So you wanna know what this fucking guy asked me to do today? You won't believe this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I... do. Thanks. So you wanna know what this fucking guy asked me to do today? You won't believe this.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: So I'm working on this looter shooter thing. You know the deal. "Epic guns, double your damage output, triple your fun with bonus Slayer Mode Coins!"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So I'm working on this looter shooter thing. You know the deal. "Epic guns, double your damage output, triple your fun with bonus Slayer Mode Coins!"

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: You don't play many games, do you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't play many games, do you?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: You're a what? A "gamer"? What a weird thing to call yourself. I like donuts. Does that make me a donuter?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a what? A "gamer"? What a weird thing to call yourself. I like donuts. Does that make me a donuter?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Games are a waste of time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Games are a waste of time.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Games are a waste of time.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Games are a waste of time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Only if you make it your whole personality.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Only if you make it your whole personality.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Only if you make it your whole personality.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Only if you make it your whole personality.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Well I love games. And I hate them. Just like everything in life I guess. They are great and terrible and everything in between. Just like people.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I love games. And I hate them. Just like everything in life I guess. They are great and terrible and everything in between. Just like people.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: No. Not like my boss. He is just terrible.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. Not like my boss. He is just terrible.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: He told me I couldn't sit next to our junior survival horror-game designer, Gordon, because there is too much sexual chemistry between us... Between me.... And Gordon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He told me I couldn't sit next to our junior survival horror-game designer, Gordon, because there is too much sexual chemistry between us... Between me.... And Gordon.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: No! And I don't care how good looking everyone says he is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No! And I don't care how good looking everyone says he is.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: No! Not at all. And I told my boss. I said we were just friends. Gordon is a fucking GREAT game designer. I love working with the dude!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No! Not at all. And I told my boss. I said we were just friends. Gordon is a fucking GREAT game designer. I love working with the dude!

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: No. He said men and women can't be real friends. He said - and listen to this bullshit - "Men want to sleep with their female friends, so real friendship is impossible between the genders."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. He said men and women can't be real friends. He said - and listen to this bullshit - "Men want to sleep with their female friends, so real friendship is impossible between the genders."

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Well first off, I don't believe it at all. But... in this case, I think Gordon kinda DOES want to sleep with me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well first off, I don't believe it at all. But... in this case, I think Gordon kinda DOES want to sleep with me.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: No. Because most of my male friends DON'T want to sleep with me. But - here's the crucial thing - if they did... who cares?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. Because most of my male friends DON'T want to sleep with me. But - here's the crucial thing - if they did... who cares?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So is your boss right after all?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So is your boss right after all?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So is your boss right after all?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So is your boss right after all?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: If a friend wants to sleep with me, and they can't, WHO CARES?! They can still be a friend. I mean, I can look at your dinner and think "I want to eat that".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If a friend wants to sleep with me, and they can't, WHO CARES?! They can still be a friend. I mean, I can look at your dinner and think "I want to eat that".

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Sexuality is weird. It just happens. But friendship is special - and it's a choice. Friendship is work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sexuality is weird. It just happens. But friendship is special - and it's a choice. Friendship is work.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Don't just keep saying "I see." Give me your opinion. What do you think?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't just keep saying "I see." Give me your opinion. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your boss is talking nonsense. Gender and sexuality has nothing to do with friendship.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your boss is talking nonsense. Gender and sexuality has nothing to do with friendship.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Your boss is talking nonsense. Gender and sexuality has nothing to do with friendship.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Your boss is talking nonsense. Gender and sexuality has nothing to do with friendship.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's true, Men never stop thinking about sex.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's true, Men never stop thinking about sex.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's true, Men never stop thinking about sex.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's true, Men never stop thinking about sex.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think he has a cynical view of relationships.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think he has a cynical view of relationships.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think he has a cynical view of relationships.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think he has a cynical view of relationships.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I get his point, but not all people are alike.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get his point, but not all people are alike.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I get his point, but not all people are alike.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I get his point, but not all people are alike.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Well, I think friendships are way more important than pretty much anything else. And Gordon is a good friend. I mean I only have like three... but he is in the top two!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I think friendships are way more important than pretty much anything else. And Gordon is a good friend. I mean I only have like three... but he is in the top two!

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Oh, I was just fooling around! I don't really rate or order my friends. I'm not weird. Or... well, I'm not weird in that particular way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I was just fooling around! I don't really rate or order my friends. I'm not weird. Or... well, I'm not weird in that particular way.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Hey, I gotta go and finish this milestone for this dumb game, but thanks for listening to my rant. As always! See ya around bud.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, I gotta go and finish this milestone for this dumb game, but thanks for listening to my rant. As always! See ya around bud.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: It doesn't mean I am making a plan to STEAL your dinner! And I won't take it by force either.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It doesn't mean I am making a plan to STEAL your dinner! And I won't take it by force either.
